newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's KFA passes on 30,000T of soymeal tenders.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's KFA passes on 30,000T of soymeal tenders.

text.p: The Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Thursday passed on tenders to buy 30,000 tonnes of soymeal due to higher-than-expected prices, traders said.
Traders said the lowest bid was made by Toepfer at $288.87 a tonne C&F with Brazilian soymeal.
Arrival was set for October 20 to the western port of Inchon.
Shipment was set for October 1-20 if sourced from China, for September 16-October 5 if from India, or for August 22-September 10 if from South America and the U.S. Gulf, they said.
